title: install skill without --yes and without a terminal shows the preview, refuses with exit 2 and writes nothing
source: intended: docs: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-9 and common rules
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-16, B4.3). No `--yes` and no terminal (the contract gives none): the preview goes to stdout, stderr is `JITSO REJECTED: this changes files: read the preview above, then run it again with --yes, or in a terminal to answer the prompt; nothing written`, exit 2. The oracle has no `install` command: it answers `unknown command "install"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so the pinned output and file effects FAIL on it.
